paragraphs: RouteSmart Technologies sells software that plans and optimizes vehicle routes for service and delivery fleets. Its routing solutions are sold for newspaper, postal and parcel, public works, and utilities operations. Waste collection work is split into residential, commercial, and roll-off routing, and the same solutions cover street sweeping, snow removal, work orders and inspections.

The software is built on Esri mapping products, and RouteSmart for ArcGIS connects the routing algorithms to that platform. Clients can also reach the solvers through a hosted environment under the name Routing-as-a-Service. FedEx acquired RouteSmart Technologies.

Named clients include the U.S. Postal Service, for which letter carrier route planning began through Electronic Data Systems. A roll-off waste solution serves commercial and municipal Public Works clients. Other named clients are Southern California Gas Company in utilities and, in newspaper distribution, the Wall Street Journal and the New York Times.

quote.text: RouteSmart’s dynamic solutions solved what other routing tools could not.
